title: xingo-extprec: extended precision and rigorous enclosures for numerical linear algebra
description:
Extended precision for numerical linear algebra in pure Rust: double-double arithmetic whose operations and elementary functions have proven error bounds, compensated sums and dot products with SIMD kernels that return the scalar results bit for bit, outward-rounded interval arithmetic without changing the rounding mode, and rigorous enclosures of sparse residuals with iterative-refinement polishing. The extended-precision layer of the Xingó solver.
